title: Varsha
desc: After his mother's death and father's arrest, Sathya brings up his seven sisters like a father. But a villainous character from his father's past turns the siblings against each other.

title: Drishya
desc: Rajendra is a family-oriented man and tries to keep them happy. However, when his family commits an accidental crime, he does everything to keep them out of harm's way.

title: Mussanje Maathu
desc: A radio jockey, Pradip, falls for Tanu, a devoted fan of his show. However, as her wedding approaches, he battles his emotions, torn between love and the reality of her commitment.

title: Pushpa: The Rise
desc: As Pushpa, a labourer, rises in the world of red sandalwood smuggling, he ends up making many enemies. However, violence ensues when the police try to topple his illegal business.

title: Cult
desc: Madhava and Geetha's village romance ends abruptly when they part ways for college in different cities. However, Madhava finds solace and new love with Ithi, who helps mend his broken heart.
